title: Draw Technology Premigration Parity for React Renderer
description: Restore the `draw` technology to premigration feature level (git tag `premigration`, deleted `draw/react/index.tsx` + `draw/core/js`) for the react renderer path, plugin-centric architecture: tool state machines/selection/overlays in `draw/plugin/rs`; booleans/trace resolved in `draw/rs` via `kernel_2d_rs` with full trace parity (pure-Rust PNG decode); generic `framework/renderer/react/components/canvas-2d-host.tsx` upgraded for gradients, blend modes, evenodd fill, arc rendering, and overlay records (selection/hover halos, marquee/lasso/preview). Full plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/greedy-spinning-duckling.md.
summary:
Restored draw to premigration feature level for the react renderer, plugin-centric architecture as planned.

draw/rs (core): added kernel_2d_rs/image/base64 deps; new SegmentGeometry region (transform/scale/split/bounds/filter path segments, SVG arc→cubic flattening per F.6.5, and curve→line sampling for the polygon-only boolean kernel); new KernelResolve region (boolean layers resolved via kernel_2d_rs::booleans::boolean_paths_many with per-child curve flattening, trace layers resolved via PNG decode→luma→kernel_2d_rs::trace::trace_bitmap_paths→artboard-scale→area-filter, matching premigration semantics including the stroke-as-fill trace fallback); removed needs_kernel/kernel_kind/kernel_payload from DrawSceneNode, added fill_rule. 8 new/updated core tests, all passing.

draw/plugin/rs: fixed a real coordinate-sign bug in canvas_point_to_world (was `- camera.x`, host used `+ camera.x` — every pick was off-origin); new ToolStateMachine region implementing modifier-aware selection merge (default/additive/subtractive/invertive, matching ui-react's marqueeModeFromModifiers), generality-ranked pick targets incl. control points, marquee/lasso hit testing, shape-drag and pen/polygon-draft preview + commit; rewrote canvasPointerDown/Move/Up as a full per-tool state machine (marquee, shapeRect/Ellipse/Line, pen/shapePolygon draft, trace-on-click, selectDirect); added canvasDoubleClick/canvasEscape/canvasCommitDraft commands + escape/enter keybindings; setCamera/setCameraZoom no longer push undo (premigration didn't undo camera); implemented tools() returning the 11-tool toolbar; render_canvas now emits a meta record (active tool, for host-side pan routing) plus leaf-expanded selection/hover halo overlays and drag preview overlays, all riding inside layersJson so the Canvas2dScene struct contract stayed untouched (wgpu-safe). 17 plugin tests, all passing.

infinite/cavas/react-renderer: extended GraphWasmSession with optional modifiers param and doubleClick; fixed a pre-existing stale path in its vitest.config.ts alias (ui/react → ui/js/react) that was silently breaking its test suite.

framework/renderer/react/components/canvas-2d-host.tsx: full scene vocabulary — Path2D-based rendering (fixes the broken arcTo hack, gives real evenodd fill across multi-contour paths), 16 blend modes → globalCompositeOperation, linear/radial gradient paint, stroke cap/join, meta-record-driven transformMove pan routing, modifier/doubleClick forwarding, dropped the now-redundant canvasWheel dispatch (setCamera already covers it).

Verified: cargo test -p draw (8/8) and -p draw-plugin (17/17) both green; framework-renderer-react and infinite-cavas vitest suites green (only pre-existing unrelated failures from concurrent WIP elsewhere in the repo, not caused by this change); rebuilt the draw plugin wasm component and browser-drove the real app at localhost:6064 — Semio Emblem renders correctly (gradients/paths/colors), marquee select, rectangle shape-tool drag, pen draft + Enter-commit, and undo all confirmed working end-to-end through the compiled plugin (verified partly via direct JS-console driving of the wasm API since a shared generated plugin registry file was being repeatedly clobbered by other concurrent sessions' dev servers — an environment race unrelated to this change). framework/renderer/wgpu was found already broken in committed history due to an unrelated concurrent UiNode::Image feature — pre-existing, out of scope, not touched.

Note: mistakenly closed ticket S-REACT-RENDERER-PREMIGRATION-PARITY (issue #1919) with this same summary text via ticket_close's default-to-latest-open behavior; immediately reopened it with a correction note.
